task.description:
The running backend (PID 25808, started 18:41) is STALE — it was started BEFORE ISSUE-FIXER added the GET /api/v1/tenants/:slug route. It must be rebuilt and restarted with the latest code.

Steps:
1. Stop the old bpm-platform process (kill PID 25808 and any zig build runner)
2. Rebuild: zig build (must exit 0)
3. Start the fresh backend with these env vars:
   - BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5432/bpm_dev
   - BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test
   - BPM_IDP_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8081
   - BPM_LISTEN_ADDR=127.0.0.1:8080
   Run via: start-backend.ps1 OR manually with zig-out/bin/bpm-platform
4. Wait for health: GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/health/ready should return 200
5. Verify the tenant routes work:
   - GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/tenants (should return 401 without auth — proves route exists)
   - GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/tenants/test-slug (should return 401 or 404 — proves route exists)
6. Run: zig build migrate (apply any pending migrations)

Return PASS only when all checks pass. Return FAIL with exact error output if anything fails.
acceptance_criteria: New backend is running and /health/ready returns 200
Both tenant routes exist (401 or 404 responses, not 405 or connection refused)

result.summary: Rebuilt and restarted backend with latest code. Old process killed, zig build exit 0, /health/ready returned 200, GET /api/v1/tenants returned 401, GET /api/v1/tenants/test-slug returned 401, zig build migrate exit 0 (no new migrations).
